hero.h1: Request a Titanium Dioxide Sample for Technical Evaluation
hero.body: Share the Malaysia-origin titanium dioxide grade you are considering—or tell us if you are not sure—together with your application, destination and test objective. We will use this context to review the request.

prefill.heading: Context brought from your previous page
prefill.body: Review any details carried into this form. You can change or remove them before submitting.

form.heading: Tell us what you need to evaluate
form.intro: Fields marked Required provide the minimum context for review.
form.warning: Please share non-confidential information only. Do not include a complete formulation, payment details or other unnecessary sensitive information.

fields.label: What do you need to evaluate?
fields.helper: Describe the result, processing question or trial objective you need to assess. Do not include a confidential formulation.

fields.label: Current grade or target requirement
fields.helper: Share a non-confidential reference point if it will help the review.

fields.label: Business email
fields.helper: Use an address where we can contact you about this request.

fields.label: Destination country or market
fields.placeholder: Enter your destination country or market
fields.helper: Enter the country or market relevant to this evaluation.

fields.label: Expected project or annual use
fields.helper: This is project context, not a requested sample quantity.

fields.label: Documents needed for the trial
fields.helper: Selection does not confirm document availability or release.

fields.label: Additional non-confidential context
fields.helper: Add only information needed to understand the evaluation.

form.privacyNotice: We use the information you provide to review and respond to your sample request. Learn more in our Privacy Policy.
form.submitHelper: Submitting starts a human review. Any sample arrangement will be confirmed separately.

errors.grade_id: Choose a product grade or select “I do not know the grade”.
errors.application_id: Choose an application, Other or Not sure.
errors.application_other: Describe the application or choose a different option.
errors.test_objective: Describe what you need to evaluate.
errors.business_email: Enter a business email address in a valid format.
errors.destination_country_market: Enter your destination country or market.

failure.heading: We could not confirm that your request was received.
failure.body: Your entries are still on this page. Please try again.

success.heading: Your sample request has been received.
success.body: Our team will review the information provided and contact you if clarification is needed. Any sample arrangement will be confirmed separately.

unavailable.heading: We cannot confirm sample requests right now.
unavailable.body: The sample request form is not available. No request has been confirmed. Please try again later.

humanReview.heading: What happens after you submit

steps.title: Request received
steps.body: Your request and the context you provided are received.

steps.title: Human review
steps.body: A person reviews the grade, application, destination and test objective.

steps.title: Clarification if needed
steps.body: We may ask for clarification if the available information is not enough.

steps.title: Separate outcome
steps.body: Any outcome is communicated separately after review.

humanReview.note: Do not know the grade? Choose the unknown-grade option and describe your application and test objective.

faq.heading: Sample request questions
faq.intro: Direct answers about the minimum information, unknown grades and human review.

items.question: What information is needed for a sample request?
items.answer: Provide your contact name, company, business email, destination, application, product grade or an unknown-grade choice, and your test objective. Optional non-confidential project context can help a person review the request.

items.question: Can I submit if I do not know the grade?
items.answer: Yes. Choose “I do not know the grade,” then describe the application and test objective. This keeps the request open for human review without creating an automatic product recommendation.

items.question: Does submission mean a sample is approved?
items.answer: No. Submitting starts a human review; it does not approve a sample or confirm any sample arrangement. Any sample arrangement will be confirmed separately.

items.question: What happens if more information is needed?
items.answer: A reviewer may ask for clarification. Any outcome is communicated separately after the request has been reviewed.

seo.description: Request a Malaysia-origin titanium dioxide sample for technical evaluation by sharing the grade, application, destination and test objective for human review.
